lists.content:
• Design and operate agentic content pipelines. Build multi-step workflows — research → outline → draft → fact-check → structure → optimise → publish — using Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n / Make / Zapier, and custom scripts. You own the workflow, not just the output.

    •  

    • Produce GEO-shaped content at scale. Comparison pages, listicles, "best of" roundups, statistics hubs, glossaries, FAQs, definitive guides, and structured Q&A — formatted for both human readers and LLM retrieval. Volume matters; so does quality. Both, not either.

      •  

      • Run off-site content campaigns. Draft and orchestrate the long tail of third-party touchpoints that build LLM-trusted authority — Reddit threads, Quora answers, niche forums, GitHub READMEs, dataset descriptions, review platforms. Always ethically, always disclosed where required.

        •  

        • Build internal tools and agents. Prototype the small utilities that save the team hours: prompt-tracking scrapers, citation monitors, content gap analysers, brand-voice linters, fact-checking agents. Think "useful internal tool" not "production SaaS."

          •  

          • Maintain editorial quality and brand voice. Agentic doesn't mean autopilot. You're the final editor on everything that ships. You design the QA loop — automated checks plus your own eye — that keeps the bar high.

            •  

            • Fact-check rigorously. LLM-assisted content fails the moment it hallucinates a stat or misattributes a source. You build verification into the workflow and personally vet anything sensitive.

              •  

              • Iterate on prompts and templates as a craft. Treat prompts and agent instructions like code: versioned, tested, documented, refactored. Share what works with the rest of the team.

                •  

                • Partner with the GEO Specialist. They'll bring the strategy and the target prompts. You translate that into a steady output of content that earns citations and visibility.

• A genuine writer's instinct. You can produce a clean, opinionated, useful piece of content from a blank page — and you can edit machine-generated drafts into something that actually reads well. Portfolio or samples expected.

    •  

    • Hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling. Daily user of Claude, ChatGPT, and at least one agentic or workflow tool (Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, Make, LangChain, or similar). You should be able to walk us through workflows you've built.

      •  

      • Light-to-moderate coding ability. Python or JavaScript at the level of "I can read API docs, write a script, debug it, and ship it." You don't need to be an engineer; you do need to not be blocked by one.

        •  

        • Prompt engineering as a real skill. You can explain why one prompt works and another doesn't, and you've built reusable prompt libraries or templates before.

          •  

          • Editorial judgement. You know when AI output is good, when it's mediocre-but-fixable, and when it needs to be thrown out and rewritten. You'd rather ship five great pieces than fifty average ones.

            •  

            • SEO/GEO literacy. You understand search intent, on-page structure, schema, internal linking, and what makes content citable. You don't need to be the strategist — but you need to speak the language.

            • Operator's mindset. Bias to ship. Comfortable owning a backlog, prioritising ruthlessly, and reporting on output without being managed.

• Experience in our category ([fintech / payments / SaaS / your vertical]).

  • A track record of building public content programs — a newsletter, a blog, a docs site — that earned organic traction.

  • Familiarity with the Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google APIs for custom agent work.

  • Background in journalism, technical writing, or developer relations.

  • Open-source contributions, public prompt libraries, or writing about agentic workflows.

This role is for engineers who understand that the future of software is Human + AI co-creation, and soon — AI-to-AI collaboration.

lists.content:
• At Unlimit, backend engineering is evolving into agent engineering.
  • You won’t simply write Java or Kotlin services. You will design and implement AI agents that build, refactor, test, and optimize those services — agents that actively participate in the software lifecycle rather than passively assisting it. Instead of creating microservices only for human consumption, you will architect systems that are self-describing, agent-consumable, and machine-operable by design.
  • Your APIs will not just be called — they will be reasoned about. AI systems will understand their contracts, constraints, and behaviors. You will help construct a full pipeline from requirements to deployment, where validation agents automatically enforce PCI-DSS rules, regulatory constraints, scalability requirements, and architectural standards. Compliance will not be a checklist at the end — it will be continuously verified by intelligent systems embedded in the flow.
  • And it won’t stop at build-time automation. You will develop autonomous monitoring agents capable of detecting anomalies, diagnosing root causes, and triggering corrective workflows in production environments operating at global financial scale. Traditional microservices will be redesigned into agent-ready execution units — modular, observable, introspectable components that machines can safely evolve.
  • You will collaborate closely with DevOps, Data, and AI teams who are building their own agents, uniting these systems into a coordinated multi-agent ecosystem that powers our financial infrastructure.
  • The outcome is simple but transformative: your code will not only serve production. It will serve the agents that run production.
    •

• A mindset that sees AI not as a tool, but as a new execution layer. You design systems where agents act, validate, and evolve software — not just assist humans.
  • Proven experience integrating LLMs, MCP servers, and multi-agent systems into real engineering workflows — not experiments, but production-oriented pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with frontier models such as Claude Opus 4.x, GPT-5.x Codex or similar — using them for structured reasoning, code generation, validation, orchestration, and system design.
  • Strong understanding of context engineering and token economics — including prompt architecture, reusable memory patterns, retrieval layers (RAG), persistent state management, and optimizing token consumption for long-horizon agent workflows.
  • Ability to design guardrails for autonomous systems — validation layers, policy enforcement, compliance checks, circuit breakers, and architectural constraints that keep AI-driven systems stable and safe.
  • 4+ years of strong Java (Spring/Spring Boot) or Kotlin experience in production environments — enabling you to validate, constrain, and refine what AI agents generate.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and scalable backend architectures in high-throughput, low-latency environments.
  • Experience designing resilient microservices capable of operating under financial-grade reliability and regulatory requirements.
  • Comfort building observable, introspectable, automation-friendly systems — because agents cannot safely operate opaque services.
  • Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively in a global AI-first organization where engineering, data, compliance, and product intersect.

• Experience in fintech, payments, or banking systems.
  • Experience working with AWS services and infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled systems or interest in integrating intelligence into applications.
  • Background in event-driven architectures and message-based systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

• Software developers will not disappear. But software development as we know it will.
  • We are transforming Unlimit into an AI-first, agent-native fintech platform.This role sits at the center of that transformation.
    • If you want to:
  • Build financial infrastructure for AI agents
  • Replace manual engineering with autonomous systems
  • Design platforms where machines are first-class users
  • Work at the frontier of fintech + AI
    • Then this is your role.

lists.content:

  • You’ll lead efforts to design, maintain, and evolve BI platforms and proprietary databases, making insights accessible and actionable for teams across the company. This includes building reports for regulators, customers, marketing, and internal stakeholders—each with its own standards and expectations. Whether it’s uncovering a trend in customer behavior, delivering a compliance-ready report, or shaping the analytics layer that supports our AI Agents, your work will guide critical business decisions.
  • This role is about more than building reports—it’s about telling the story behind the data. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, align data outputs with business needs, and set the standards for how analytics are delivered at Unlimit. - dbt — building models, writing tests and macros, data contracts.
- Python, including the ability to build lightweight data-facing applications (Streamlit or a comparable framework).
- 3+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI development on a modern cloud warehouse.

- Advanced English.
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field.

Nice to Have:

- BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc) for ad-hoc reporting alongside the Streamlit platform
- Cloud infrastructure exposure (AWS / Azure / GCP)
- Prior consulting experience in financial services data
- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, IaaC
- AI-assisted and agentic development

We are looking for a Business Growth and Partnerships Manager to drive the expansion of our business accounts offering across key European markets. This role is focused on building and scaling a partner-led distribution engine, with a primary focus on establishing strong relationships with corporate service providers, company formation agents (registrators), consulting firms, and legal and accounting partners.

The core objective is to create a predictable, high-volume referral channel where partners consistently introduce qualified business clients. Success in this role is defined by the ability to onboard and activate partners who generate scalable client flow, rather than acquiring individual clients directly.

You will also embed the company within local entrepreneurial ecosystems, including startups, tech, and e-commerce communities, to strengthen market presence and unlock additional partnership opportunities. This role requires a high level of ownership and autonomy, with a strong focus on execution, long-term relationship building, and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner Acquisition & Relationship Building
    Identify and build relationships with corporate service providers, law firms, registrators, consulting firms, and key industry influencers. Drive a consistent partner-driven pipeline to generate high-quality client referrals. 
  • Fiduciary and Industry Association Engagement
    Engage with relevant fiduciary and industry associations, negotiate sponsorships, and participate in events to secure introductions to strategic partners. 
  • Event Strategy & Execution
    Plan and organize events for partners with support from the marketing team to strengthen relationships, generate leads, and enhance brand presence. 
  • Strategic Partner & Client Meetings
    Conduct targeted meetings with high-potential partners and top clients to drive referrals and identify new account opportunities. 
  • Industry Participation
    Represent the company at corporate, legal, and industry conferences to expand networks and uncover partnership opportunities. 
  • Community Engagement
    Identify and engage key entrepreneurial and business communities in tech, IT, e-commerce, digital marketing and other industries. Establish partnerships or sponsorships to position the company and its founders as trusted industry leaders. 
  • Partner and Client Onboarding
    Onboard new partners and ensure their clients receive a fast, efficient, and high-priority onboarding experience. Collaborate with internal teams to maintain quality and compliance standards. 

    • Success Metrics:

    • Number of activated partners and partner-driven client accounts 
    • Quality and volume of onboarded accounts
    • Engagement within partners, entrepreneurial ecosystems (events organization)

      • Required Skills

      • Proven experience in B2B partnerships / business development
      • Strong ability to build and manage partner networks (legal, consulting, corporate services)
      • Experience driving partner-led or referral-based client acquisition
      • Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills
      • Experience in event participation and networking within industry ecosystems
      • Ability to work independently with high ownership and execution focus
      • Strong stakeholder management skills (partners, clients, internal teams)

        • Nice to Have

        • Familiarity with startup / tech / e-commerce ecosystems
        • Experience in fintech, banking, or B2B SaaS
        • Existing network in European markets

  • Proactively engage with scheme representatives to identify collaboration opportunities and strategic initiatives
  •  Represent the company in external meetings, workshops, and scheme events, ensuring strong brand positioning
  • Build trust-based relationships to facilitate smoother approvals, waivers, and support from schemes
  •  Identify opportunities for participation in:
    1. pilot programs
    2. scheme-led initiatives
    3. innovation projects

  • Serve as the primary liaison with global card schemes and payments-related partners, managing day-to-day tasks and ongoing communication
  • To lead and coordinate implementation projects involving card schemes, ensuring alignment across teams on a global basis
  • Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and control frameworks to ensure ongoing adherence to card scheme regulations and industry standards

  • Translate scheme rules into internal processes and technical requirements

  • Support ongoing and targeted compliance monitoring against Card Scheme rules
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with card scheme mandates, proactively managing risks and securing waivers when deadlines cannot be met

We are seeking an experienced Card Scheme to join our team and help ensure smooth collaboration, growth and compliance with international card schemes (Mastercard, Visa, UPI, Discover and etc). This is a key operational role, suited for someone with a strong background in online payments or card networks, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to navigate both structured daily tasks and larger, cross-functional initiatives.

To help accomplish your responsibilities, you will work closely with the Product, Compliance, Card Processing team, PSP, Legal and other department to align business initiatives with scheme requirements.
 
Fluent English – must.

lists.content:
1. Scheme Relationship & Project Management
- Serve as the primary liaison with global card schemes and payments-related partners, managing day-to-day tasks and ongoing communication
- To lead and coordinate implementation projects involving card schemes, ensuring alignment across teams on a global basis
- Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and control frameworks to ensure ongoing adherence to card scheme regulations and industry standards
-  Engage regularly with internal stakeholders to translate scheme requirements into practical solutions
- Provide guidance and ongoing assistance to internal teams, including Underwriting, Account Management, PSP, Processing around Card Scheme rules and requirements
- Effectively document business/technical requirements and understand operational processes
- This is a dynamic, cross-functional, and key role in working with some of the key payment schemes such as Visa, MasterCard, China Union Pay, JCB, American Express, Discover, and other local smaller nimble players.

2. Scheme Mandates & Compliance

- Monitor Bulletins, Mandatory Changes, and Global Releases
- Ensure timely implementation of scheme requirements across teams
- Translate scheme rules into internal processes and technical requirements
- Maintain internal policies, procedures, and control frameworks
- Support ongoing and targeted compliance monitoring against Card Scheme rules
- Ensure ongoing compliance with card scheme mandates, proactively managing risks and securing waivers when deadlines cannot be met
- Respond to non-compliance notifications raised by Card Schemes

3. Automation (AI) of Scheme Processes

- Design and implement automation for:
a. mandate tracking
b. impact assessment
c. ticket creation and routing

-  Reduce manual workload in:
d. compliance monitoring
e. reporting
f. certification tracking

- Develop internal tools:
o AI assistants for scheme documentation
o Smart search across Visa/Mastercard and other rules

4.  Certification & Product Launches
-  Lead end-to-end certification:
o Acquiring & Issuing card products
o 3DS / tokenization
o Apple Pay / Google Pay
-  Coordinate processors, vendors, and scheme stakeholders

- 4-5 years of experience with Card Schemes, Merchant Acquiring, PSP
-  Strong knowledge of Visa/Mastercard rules, with specific experience in Card Not Present Payments
- Proven ability to navigate Card Scheme relationships and compliance issues
-  Ability to convince colleagues and stress the importance of compliance requirements to protect our brand
-  Solid communication skills, specifically you will be able to connect with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and merchants from varying disciplines and cultures
- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills
-  Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks in parallel, with high attention to deadlines
-  Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-demand environments; ability to remain calm and deliver results under pressure
-  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft formal correspondence
-  Proactive mindset - ability to identify issues before they arise and take initiative
-  Strong and effective leadership skills and ability to operate comfortably and independently within a complex cultural, global environment
-  Professional fluency in English (written and spoken); other languages are an advantage
-Understanding of high-risk business models and associated risk drivers In-depth understanding of regulatory and card scheme requirements

As a Head Account Management, you will serve as the primary architect of growth for Unlimit’s merchant portfolio in the US market. This is a high-impact, revenue-centric role designed for a visionary who excels at transforming relationships into scalable commercial ecosystems.

You won’t just manage accounts; you will orchestrate long-term strategic roadmaps, identifying untapped opportunities for Unlimit’s acquiring solutions and delivering bespoke value that ensures our partners thrive in an ever-evolving digital economy.

• Act as the lead consultant for key merchants and payment partners, aligning Unlimit’s innovative suite of products with their long-term business objectives.

  • Drive the commercial evolution of your portfolio by identifying high-value opportunities for expansion, integration, and cross-functional solution adoption.

  • Leverage deep data analytics to provide partners with actionable insights, optimizing their performance and reinforcing Unlimit’s position as an indispensable growth catalyst.

  • Collaborate with Global Product, Risk, and Engineering teams to refine the merchant journey, ensuring our infrastructure anticipates the needs of the US market.

  • Represent Unlimit at the highest levels of industry engagement, embodying our commitment to "unlimiting" business potential through trust, expertise, and personalized ownership.

  • Expertly navigate complex stakeholder environments, balancing high-stakes priorities with a focus on flawless execution and fiscal excellence.

• 6+ years of sophisticated experience in Payments, Acquiring, or Fintech Partnerships. You don’t just know the industry; you understand its future.
  • A proven track record of growing multi-million dollar portfolios through strategic upselling and value-based negotiation.
  • You possess the ability to translate complex data sets into compelling narratives that drive executive decision-making.
  • A proactive, resilient self-starter who thrives in high-velocity environments and views challenges as opportunities for innovation.
  • A high-EQ collaborator who brings energy to the team and champions a culture of high performance, inclusivity, and professional excellence.

This is not a traditional "account management" position. It is an opportunity to own a critical piece of the US payments landscape within one of the world’s most ambitious fintechs. If you are ready to move beyond maintenance and into true growth partnership, Unlimit is your platform.

As Head of Business Growth, USA, you will be the driving force behind Unlimit’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. You will own and execute the go-to-market strategy, build and lead a high-performing commercial team, and establish Unlimit as a dominant fintech infrastructure partner across the region.

You will play a critical role in expanding our footprint across enterprise and high-growth segments, forging key partnerships, and unlocking new revenue streams. Working at the intersection of finance, technology, and AI-native infrastructure, you will help shape how businesses—and autonomous agents—interact with global financial systems.

This is a leadership role with direct influence on revenue, market positioning, and long-term strategic direction in the US.

We’re looking for a commercially driven, strategic leader with a strong track record in fintech or payments, and deep understanding of the US market.

  • Proven experience (10+ years) in commercial leadership roles within fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure

  • Strong track record of driving revenue growth, scaling teams, and delivering against ambitious targets

  • Deep understanding of the cross border payments ecosystem

  • Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for complex, API-driven or platform-based products

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and scale high-performing commercial teams (sales, partnerships, account management)

  • Strong network across enterprise, and high-growth tech companies in the US

  • Strategic thinker with hands-on execution mindset

  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, and globally distributed organizations

  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations teams

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

• Full ownership of a revenue stream, with the mandate to build and scale Unlimit’s commercial acquiring partnerships worldwide

  • The chance to create and shape a new direction for the business — leading landmark deals, opening new markets, and designing the global partner ecosystem from the ground up

Responsibilities / Job Description

  • Be the First Responder: Serve as the primary point of contact for all incoming IT support requests via our ticketing system, email, chat channels, or walk-ups, for all our employees.

  • Triage & Troubleshoot: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and basic network issues. Know when to fix it on the spot and when to escalate complex issues to higher tier Support Team(s).

  • Manage the User Lifecycle: Execute onboarding and offboarding processes. Create accounts in Active Directory/Google Workspace/MFA, configure workstations, and set up secure access.

  • Deploy & Maintain Hardware: Prepare, image, and deploy both Windows and macOS devices. Help procure and maintain office tech, including monitors, docking stations, conference room AV equipment, office cable management.

  • Support Equipment Procurement: Help with local hardware/software vendor communication, coordination and procurement.
  • Office Access: Support our Security Team in maintaining our office access systems used by employees and visitors.

  • Server Room: This role will also bear responsibility for maintaining our local systems, hosted in the local server room. Experience and strong understanding of Active Directory Domain Services and virtualization tools (VMware, vSphere..) is required.

  • Educate, Document & Automate: Write clear, simple "How-To" guides for our internal knowledge base to help users solve common problems on their own. Support the automation processes for recurring/routine tasks, which will also rely on AI-driven workplace support.

Relevant experience

  • The Essentials: 3+ years of experience in Workplace and AD Domain Services technical support roles.

  • End user support and automation mindset: You possess excellent communication skills in English (Russian is a plus), and the patience to explain technical concepts to non-technical staff. You are good at identifying patterns and automation opportunities.

  • Core Tech Experience: Strong hands-on experience in troubleshooting and administration of Windows, macOS, Google business suite, MS Office and related tools. Experience with AI-assisted automation.

  • L2 Administration: Strong understanding and experience with user, group and security policies management via Active Directory and Google Admin console. Experience in centralized device/IT inventory & asset management.

  • Hardware: A strong understanding of IT hardware, peripherals, and IP networks concepts and technologies.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with working in as well as administration of IT Service Management tools like ManageEngine and Atlassian Jira.

  • Strong familiarity with creating and running PowerShell commands & scripts.

  • Experience supporting Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive) in a corporate setting.

  • Familiarity and basic understanding of ITIL.

  • Relevant IT certifications.

descriptionPlain:
About Unlimit
 
Unlimit is the global fintech powerhouse behind the world’s largest proprietary payments infrastructure.
Founded in 2009, Unlimit operates across 17 global offices with 700+ experts, seamlessly integrating 1,000+ payment methods into a single platform. From London to São Paulo, we empower businesses to scale across borders with a unified suite of financial tools — including payment processing, alternative payment methods, multicurrency business accounts, card issuing, banking-as-a-service, and crypto on- and off-ramps.
Our mission is to break down financial barriers and enable seamless money movement across borders. We give forward-thinking businesses the tools to accept, send, and manage payments effortlessly, wherever they operate.
 
Summary
 
We are looking for a Lead Oracle Developer to design, optimize, and evolve Unlimit’s enterprise-grade Oracle data platforms that power our global financial systems. You will lead database design and performance initiatives across OLTP and OLAP environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and seamless integration with data pipelines and AI-driven analytics.
 
 
What you will be doing
 
At Unlimit, data sits at the heart of our products — from payments and Banking-as-a-Service to AI-enabled solutions. As a Lead Oracle Developer, you will shape the future of our data architecture, ensuring our databases are optimized, secure, and ready to support real-time operations at global scale.You’ll define and drive the evolution of Oracle database development across high-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) systems. Working closely with application teams, data engineers, and DBAs, you’ll plan and deliver complex database releases, review critical code, and ensure that performance, integrity, and reliability standards are consistently met.You will lead a small team of developers, set priorities, and guide them in implementing best practices for design, testing, and optimization. Beyond traditional development, you’ll partner with platform and data teams to integrate Oracle data flows with modern pipelines, analytics systems, and AI workloads — ensuring that the foundation we build today supports the intelligent systems of tomorrow.This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who thrives on performance tuning, process improvement, and empowering others to deliver excellence.
 
Qualifications
6+ years of professional experience in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development, ideally at or above OCP (Oracle Certified Professional) level.
Solid understanding of OLTP and OLAP systems, including design, performance optimization, and maintenance.
Proven experience developing and supporting 24x7 high-availability systems.
Strong skills in query tuning, indexing, partitioning, and performance diagnostics using AWR/ASH or equivalent tools.Experience leading or mentoring a team of developers (2+ people).Proficiency with Git for version control and release management.Structured analytical thinking and attention to detail.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related IT field.
English proficiency (B2 or higher) for effective collaboration in a global environment.
 
Nice to have
Knowledge of data warehouse design principles and ETL integration.
Familiarity with AI or analytics workloads that leverage Oracle or hybrid data architectures.
Experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform for database provisioning.
Understanding of PostgreSQL or cloud-managed databases (e.g., Aurora, RDS).
Proven ability to collaborate across teams to resolve production performance and scalability challenges.

This role demands a blend of deep payment expertise and strong technical understanding to ensure every integration is robust, stable, and delivers maximum value for our merchants and their customers.
You will operate at the intersection of product, technology, and operations, partnering closely with Engineering to define how payment methods are designed, how they perform, and how they scale within the Unlimit ecosystem.
 
Core Responsibilities:

lists.content:
• Lead the full lifecycle of APMs: from initial research and planning through integration, launch, continuous monitoring, and optimization.
  • Ensure the reliability and efficiency of each payment method, aligning them with critical business and market requirements.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with external payment partners and internal cross-functional technical teams.

• Contribute to the creation of detailed requirements, functional flows, and acceptance criteria for new APM integrations.
  • Collaborate directly with Engineering to ensure integrations adhere to best practices and meet operational demands.
  • Utilize your understanding of APIs, callbacks, and payment flow architecture to guide solution discussions and accelerate delivery.
  • Coordinate dependencies across teams (Engineering, QA, Operations, Compliance) to achieve smooth and timely releases.

• Analyze key performance indicators such as success rate, conversion, latency, declines, and transaction errors.
  • Work with Engineering and Support to investigate issues and identify root causes.
  • Proactively use monitoring tools (dashboards, logs, alerts) and data insights to detect problems and drive platform improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to refine user journeys and reduce payment friction.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global APM trends, provider capabilities, and regulatory shifts.
  • Evaluate new payment opportunities, providing recommendations based on market fit, merchant demand, and technical complexity.
  • Understand country-specific consumer payment behaviors and leverage these insights in product decisions.

• Develop clear internal documentation, flow diagrams, and guides for Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to articulate the value proposition of payment methods to merchants.
  • Drive go-to-market efforts for new launches, ensuring complete organizational alignment.

• Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure every payment method adheres to all applicable rules, regulations, and licensing requirements.
  • Ensure solutions are operationally sound, scalable, and aligned with core platform standards.

• Experience: 5+ years in payments, fintech, product delivery, or a related field (6+ years for Senior Specialist).
  • Payment Fundamentals: Solid understanding of online payment mechanisms, including basic payment flows, settlement, notification systems, and API integrations.
  • Engineering Partnership: Proven experience working closely with engineering teams and actively contributing to technical solution design.
  • Analytical Skillset: A strong analytical mindset with proficiency in interpreting data, identifying trends, and using insights to make data-driven decisions.
  • Collaboration: Highly organized, collaborative, and capable of managing multiple stakeholders and driving results across various teams.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to communicate complex ideas, translating seamlessly between business needs and technical specifications.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving technological environment.

• Competitive compensation package based on experience.
  • Comprehensive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Standard Monday–Friday work week.
  • Modern, fully-equipped office environment.A multicultural team and excellent opportunities for professional growth and learning.

lists.content:
• Own GEO strategy end-to-end. Define what "winning" looks like across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and emerging surfaces. Prioritise the prompts, categories, and buyer journeys that matter most to revenue.

    •  

    • Audit and reverse-engineer LLM behaviour. Track which sources the major models cite for our category, why they cite them, and where we're missing. Build a repeatable methodology for diagnosing visibility gaps.

      •  

      • Optimise content for retrieval and citation. Restructure existing pages and brief new ones with LLM-friendly patterns: clear claims, citable statistics, structured Q&A, comparison tables, schema markup, semantic clarity. Coach writers and SMEs on what makes content quotable by an AI.

        •  

        • Build third-party authority. LLMs trust what the open web trusts. Plan and execute campaigns to seed mentions, reviews, and citations on the sources models actually pull from — Reddit, G2, Wikipedia, industry publications, structured datasets, GitHub, Stack Overflow, and others relevant to our category.

          •  

          • Engineer the technical foundation. Crawlability for AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), llms.txt, structured data, entity consolidation, internal linking, and site architecture that supports retrieval. Partner with engineering on implementation.

            •  

            • Stand up monitoring and reporting. Implement and operate tooling (Profound, Peec AI, Otterly.AI, AthenaHQ, Scrunch, or equivalents) plus custom prompt-tracking pipelines. Report share-of-voice, citation rate, sentiment, and competitive position — and tie them to pipeline and revenue where possible.

              • Run a continuous experiment program. Hypothesis → test → measure → document. Build the internal knowledge base so wins compound and don't live in one person's head.

• 5+ years in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing, with a clear track record of moving organic visibility metrics for a real business.

          •

            •  

            • Excellent written communication. You can produce, edit, and brief content that's both genuinely useful to a human reader and structured to be cited by a model.

This role blends Linux systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and automation with a strong focus on service availability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

lists.content:
• Platform reliability & operations:
  • Ensure the availability, resilience, and performance of the platform and supporting services.
  • Own and improve incident management, including troubleshooting, escalation handling, and follow-ups aligned to SLAs.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, supporting production systems and driving reliability improvements from real incidents.
  • Infrastructure engineering (Linux / Cloud / Kubernetes):
  • Design, deploy, configure, and manage Linux-based system architecture across environments.
  • Build and support platform implementations using AWS and other cloud technologies (compute-centric services and related infrastructure).
  • Design and implement large and complex technology projects, from initial design through production rollout and operational handover.
  • Support and maintain Kubernetes-based workloads and platform components.
  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code:
  • Build tooling and solutions to automate recurring operational tasks.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to standardize and scale: Terraform for provisioning , Ansible for configuration management and automation
  • Improve reliability by reducing manual steps and enabling repeatable deployments.
  • CI/CD & developer enablement:
  • Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines across 20+ repositories spanning multiple technology stacks.
  • Partner with Engineering teams to improve build/release consistency, pipeline reliability, and deployment safety.
  • Observability & operational readiness:
  • Implement and enhance monitoring, logging, and alerting, using tools such as: Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Splunk, PagerDuty (or equivalent incident alerting/response tooling).
  • Use metrics and incident learnings to reduce noise, improve signal, and shorten time-to-detect/time-to-recover.
  • Documentation & standards:
  • Produce clear, formal documentation including: Configuration standards, Troubleshooting runbooks, Infrastructure and architecture design documentation.
  • Contribute to internal standards that improve consistency, security, and operational maturity.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in Linux systems administration / engineering in production environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of the following (or equivalents): Linux, Kubernetes, GitLab, Terraform, Ansible.
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum) teams.
  • Experience with AWS (compute-focused services) and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Proven experience with distributed systems design, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong scripting/coding ability in at least one of: Python, Golang, bash.
  • Experience with observability and incident response tooling such as: Zabbix, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty.
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively with customers, vendors, partners, and internal teams across levels.
  • Working knowledge (expected familiarity) with datastores and messaging systems such as: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ. Also Web/application infrastructure components such as: Apache, Nginx
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, work independently, make good decisions, and collaborate as a team player in fast-changing environments.
  • Strong AI-driven mindset and curiosity about emerging AI technologies.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLMs, automation frameworks, AI-assisted development tools) to enhance productivity or system performance.

• Experience operating highly available, high-volume web services.
  • Strong initiative and self-starter attitude with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated success reducing operational toil through automation and better tooling.
  • Experience improving SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, or formal reliability practices (if applicable to your background).

  • Conduct in-depth troubleshooting of complex transaction failures, including authorization declines, settlement discrepancies, callback issues, and routing problems.
  • Perform real-time analysis using logging and monitoring tools (Kibana, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk) to quickly diagnose system anomalies and errors.

Our mission is to be “ready for tomorrow,” providing our customers with stability in the ever-changing financial landscape and empowering them to seize opportunities ahead of the curve. While others observe, our customers take the lead.

About The Job
As a Temenos Lead Specialist at Unlimit, you will be at the forefront of architecting, integrating, and evolving our Temenos ecosystem to power next-generation payments and banking services. This is more than an implementation role — you’ll lead cross-functional initiatives, guide technical teams, and leverage AI-driven insights to optimize performance, scalability, and compliance. 

You’ll be responsible for defining best practices, driving end-to-end delivery of complex configurations, and ensuring our Temenos solutions stay ahead of business demands and regulatory changes. From enabling intelligent automation in transaction flows to enhancing data-driven decision-making, your leadership will ensure our systems operate with precision, resilience, and innovation.

If you’re ready to lead high-impact projects, mentor specialists, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in modern core banking with AI-powered agility — we want you on our team.

What you will be doing
At Unlimit, AI is not a marketing buzzword — it is the operating principle behind how we build, run, and evolve our banking systems. As the Temenos Lead Specialist, you will lead the transformation of our Temenos ecosystem into an AI-native, self-optimizing core that can adapt to market shifts and regulatory changes in real time. You will work at the intersection of architecture, integration, and innovation, ensuring that Temenos Transact (T24) is not just implemented, but reimagined as a platform where AI-agents autonomously handle complex operational workflows — from intelligent payment routing to proactive exception resolution — freeing human teams to focus on growth and strategy.

You will be responsible for crafting and executing a forward-looking architecture strategy that makes annual Temenos upgrades nearly effortless, ensuring we remain continuously aligned with the latest capabilities without disruption to business operations. This will include designing AI-enabled monitoring and automation pipelines so our systems not only detect and respond to performance bottlenecks, but anticipate them before they occur. You will drive the integration of Temenos with real-time data streams, external fintech ecosystems, and predictive analytics engines, enabling our AI-agents to act decisively.

Your leadership will guide technical teams to think beyond traditional banking solutions, fostering a culture where compliance, scalability, and innovation coexist without trade-offs. You will work closely with business and regulatory stakeholders to ensure that every enhancement, integration, and upgrade advances our strategic vision of a core banking platform that is resilient, agile, and perpetually ahead of the curve. In this role, you will not merely configure Temenos — you will architect its evolution into an AI-empowered backbone for global payments and banking.

lists.content:
1. Development & Customization
    - Design, develop, and implement customizations and enhancements in Temenos Transact (T24)
    using TAFJ, Design Studio, Extensibility Framework, API workbench.
    - Build and maintain core banking modules including Arrangement Architecture (AA) etc.
    - Good experience of Integration Framework.
    - Develop and optimize T24 online and COB routines and Services Framework components.

  2. Integration & Interfacing
    - Lead integration efforts using Temenos Integration Framework, IRIS (Interaction Framework),
    MQ, and REST/SOAP APIs.
    - Implement event-driven and streaming integrations using Event Streaming and Adapter
    Frameworks.
    - Collaborate with infrastructure and middleware teams to ensure seamless data exchange and
    system interoperability.

  3. Testing & Support
    - Conduct unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for all developed components.
    - Provide L3 support for production issues, performance tuning, and defect resolution.
    - Maintain comprehensive documentation including technical specifications, installation guides,
    and test results.


  4. Collaboration & Leadership
    - Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, and Project Managers to translate functional
    requirements into technical solutions.
    - Mentor junior developers and contribute to continuous improvement of development
    practices.

- 7+ years of hands-on experience in Temenos Transact (T24) development.
- Strong proficiency in TAFJ, JBASE, Java, Python, and SQL.
- Experience with Temenos Integration Framework, IRIS, MQ, and API development.
- Familiarity with cloud deployment (AWS preferred) and containerization (Docker, OpenShift,
Kubernetes).
- Knowledge of logging and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Dynatrace and Splunk.
- Exposure to Temenos Extensibility Framework and hybrid integration approaches.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

-Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
- Temenos certifications (Transact, Payments, Integration Framework).
- Experience with T24 upgrades, data migration, and performance optimization.
